message.content: On September 16, 2026, LiHua expressed enthusiasm and excitement about the idea of incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. She suggested that this approach would make their sessions more fun and creative, challenging them to grow as musicians, and potentially allowing everyone to showcase their individual talents. LiHua was looking forward to trying out this new method, which she believed would add spontaneity and excitement to their practice sessions. Additionally, she seemed eager to see how everyone would contribute during these improvised moments. This indicates that LiHua is very receptive to and supportive of the idea of improvisation.
